frozen_candidate_root_contribution: صَيْحَة = a single, discrete, bounded audible sound-event — one loud cry/shout/blast that is heard. Force-neutral and source-unspecified: the root contributes only the overwhelming sonic emission, not destruction, not a divine agent, not eschatological status, and not durativity.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: صَيْحَة = a single, discrete, bounded audible sound-event — one loud cry/shout/blast that is heard. Force-neutral and source-unspecified: the root contributes only the overwhelming sonic emission, not destruction, not a divine agent, not eschatological status, and not durativity.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root ص ي ح surfaces in the packet only as the feminine noun صَيْحَة (form N, 13×); there are no verbs or other derivations, so the root claim is co-extensive with this single noun. Twelve of thirteen occurrences sit in scenes of sudden divine annihilation or eschatological upheaval (a people 'seized' by the Ṣayḥah, or a single Ṣayḥah that extinguishes or gathers them), which invites reading 'destructive/cosmic Blast' into the word itself. That inflated reading is refuted internally: (a) the identical phrase صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً both kills at 54:31 (كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ) and raises for assembly at 36:53 (مُحْضَرُونَ), so the outcome is supplied by context, not the noun; and (b) 63:4 applies the same noun to ordinary, countable, harmless shouts (كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ). What survives across all 13 is a thin acoustic nucleus: the Ṣayḥah is something HEARD (50:42 يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ), counted as one bounded event (صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً ×5; singulative فَعْلة), and distinguished from non-acoustic destruction modes (29:40 lists it beside حَاصِب, خَسْف, إغراق). Lethality, uniqueness, cosmic scale and divine agency are all carried by the surrounding syntax (أَخَذَ / أَرْسَلْنَا / بِٱلْحَقِّ / وَٰحِدَة / result clauses), never by صَيْحَة.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: صَيْحَة does NOT entail: (1) destruction/punishment — 63:4 is harmless and 36:53/50:42 produce resurrection-gathering, not death; (2) a fixed source or mechanism — sometimes God sends it (54:31 أَرْسَلْنَا), often unstated, in 63:4 mere ambient noise; (3) uniqueness — oneness is done by وَٰحِدَة, while كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ (63:4) shows it is countable/recurring; (4) articulate speech or a message — 63:4 contrasts لِقَوْلِهِمْ (their speech) with صَيْحَة (raw sound); (5) durativity/iteration — وَٰحِدَة + مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ (38:15) + immediate فَإِذَا-results mark a punctual one-shot event; (6) fixed magnitude/scale — the same word covers a people-annihilating event and a single mundane outcry.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 63:4:14:1 «يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ» — the hypocrites reckon EVERY ṣayḥah is against them: an indefinite, كُلّ-pluralized, mundane, non-lethal social outcry. This one verse strips 'cosmic', 'unique', 'divine-agent', and 'lethal' out of the nucleus, proving the destructive force in the other twelve is contextual, not lexical, and forcing the root sense down to a plain audible cry/shout.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A two-class / lexicalized reading: (A) the definite ٱلصَّيْحَة as a frozen theological term, 'the Blast' of divine judgment/resurrection (12×, always definite when it is the agent of أَخَذَ, suggesting a known fixed referent), vs. (B) صَيْحَة as an ordinary 'shout' (only 63:4). This loses because the split is bridged Quran-internally, not merely dismissed: 50:42 makes the very eschatological Blast the direct object of hearing (يَسْمَعُونَ), i.e. it is conceived as an auditory cry — the same nucleus 63:4 exhibits; the frame عَلَيْهِمْ is shared by the divine Blast (54:31 أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً) and the mundane shout (63:4 صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ); بِٱلْحَقِّ attaches to both the destroying Blast (23:41) and the summoning Blast (50:42); and morphology gives no support for a split — one noun differing only in case/definiteness, where definiteness is discourse-anaphoric, not a lexical-class marker. One thin nucleus is more economical than positing homonymy.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: A two-class / lexicalized reading: (A) the definite ٱلصَّيْحَة as a frozen theological term, 'the Blast' of divine judgment/resurrection (12×, always definite when it is the agent of أَخَذَ, suggesting a known fixed referent), vs. (B) صَيْحَة as an ordinary 'shout' (only 63:4). This loses because the split is bridged Quran-internally, not merely dismissed: 50:42 makes the very eschatological Blast the direct object of hearing (يَسْمَعُونَ), i.e. it is conceived as an auditory cry — the same nucleus 63:4 exhibits; the frame عَلَيْهِمْ is shared by the divine Blast (54:31 أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً) and the mundane shout (63:4 صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ); بِٱلْحَقِّ attaches to both the destroying Blast (23:41) and the summoning Blast (50:42); and morphology gives no support for a split — one noun differing only in case/definiteness, where definiteness is discourse-anaphoric, not a lexical-class marker. One thin nucleus is more economical than positing homonymy.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses (two constructive, one adversarial) independently converge on a single force-neutral acoustic nucleus and independently reject the inflated punitive nucleus. The convergence rests on: positive auditory attestation (50:42 يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ); singulative morphology corroborated by وَٰحِدَة ×5; a generic countable non-lethal use (63:4 كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ); and an internal contrast set naming Ṣayḥah as the sonic modality distinct from wind/stones, earth-swallowing and drowning (29:40). The kill-vs-raise minimal pair on the identical phrase صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً (54:31 vs 36:53) is decisive proof that outcome is external to the word. The genuine residual limits are honestly recorded: audibility is directly attested only at 50:42 (inferential for the six-verse seizure cluster), and vocal-cry vs non-vocal-blast is underdetermined — but neither undermines the acoustic-singulative nucleus, which no occurrence contradicts. Hence PREFERRED / UNIVERSAL / STRONG for the thin nucleus, with the punitive/cosmic reading recorded as a dominant contextual specialization, not root content.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The definite ٱلصَّيْحَة as the specific decisive sound-event that 'seizes' (أَخَذَ/أَخَذَتْ) a wrongdoing nation at an ordinary daytime hour (مُشْرِقِينَ/مُصْبِحِينَ), producing annihilation. The auditory nucleus is present but here reaches these verses inferentially, via the shared lexeme and the anaphoric definite; the lethal/destructive weight is carried by أَخَذَ and the result clauses, not the noun.
clusters.classification_rationale: Definite ٱلصَّيْحَة as grammatical subject/object of the seizing verb in past historical-annihilation frames; distinguished internally at 29:40, which lists ٱلصَّيْحَة as one destruction modality beside حَاصِب (stones/gale), خَسْف (earth-swallowing) and إغراق (drowning), fixing its distinguishing facet as the sonic mode.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 29:40:12:2 places ٱلصَّيْحَة in an explicit contrast set of destruction modalities (حَاصِب / خَسْف / إغراق), so it is the auditory member, not a generic 'destruction' word. Residual tension: 23:41:2:2 «فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءً» reduces bodies to scum, weight beyond pure acoustics — but the effect is asserted by فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ, never described acoustically, so it is contextual, not lexical.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Indefinite صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً — a single, discrete, punctual sound-event whose immediate result clause (فَإِذَا / فَكَانُوا) shows instantaneity. The numeral وَٰحِدَة supplies uniqueness and مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ (38:15) supplies non-recurrence; the noun itself contributes only the one bounded sonic emission.
clusters.classification_rationale: Indefinite accusative صَيْحَةً in the fixed counted phrase وَٰحِدَةً; groups the eschatological one-shot uses whose outcomes range from extinguishing (36:29 خَٰمِدُونَ) to gathering (36:53 مُحْضَرُونَ) to pulverizing (54:31 كَهَشِيمِ).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Decisive internal minimal pair: the identical phrase صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً both kills at 54:31:4:1 «فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ» and raises/gathers at 36:53:4:1 «فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ», proving the destructive/resurrective outcome is not carried by the noun. Residual tension at 54:31:4:1: a sound 'sent upon them' that pulverizes reads as a physical blast, but the mechanism is never described acoustically and the effect is asserted by فَكَانُوا, so it is contextual.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: ٱلصَّيْحَة as the direct object of hearing (يَسْمَعُونَ) inaugurating يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ — the single most important datum fixing the category as auditory: one hears a sound, not a catastrophe, and here the sound summons emergence, not death.
clusters.classification_rationale: The lone occurrence where صَيْحَة is the object of سمع; it is the acoustic anchor that licenses the auditory nucleus across the whole packet and bridges the punitive and mundane poles.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 50:42:3:2 «يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ» — direct auditory attestation; بِٱلْحَقِّ here also attaches to the summoning Blast, the same modifier used for the destroying Blast at 23:41, binding both eschatological poles under one auditory term.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: صَيْحَة as an ordinary, countable, recurring, non-lethal social outcry that the fearful mis-perceive as hostile. Establishes the base sense — a loud cry/shout — independent of any punishment or eschatological scenario.
clusters.classification_rationale: Indefinite genitive after كُلّ ('every'), mundane this-worldly frame; the anomaly relative to the dominant Blast pattern that confirms the thin acoustic nucleus.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 63:4:14:1 «يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ» contrasts within the same verse لِقَوْلِهِمْ (articulate speech, heard) against صَيْحَة (raw sound), showing صَيْحَة is loud sound, not words, and is countable/plural, not a unique cosmic event.

adversarial_verification.notes: The refutation targeted the inflated 'destructive/cosmic Blast' nucleus and it was disproven internally (54:31↔36:53 kill-vs-raise on identical صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً; 63:4 mundane non-lethal). The surviving thin acoustic-singulative nucleus was then tested for falsifiability (63:4 could have contradicted it but instead exhibits the plain heard-cry sense) and for distinctiveness (29:40 names صَيْحَة as the sonic modality distinct from حَاصِب/خَسْف/إغراق, so it is not a generic 'destruction' or generic 'event' word). No occurrence contradicts the auditory-singulative nucleus, so failing_occurrences is empty.

layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The dominant punitive/eschatological 'decisive Blast' sense (12/13) is a contextual specialization supplied by أَخَذَ/أَخَذَتْ, أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ, بِٱلْحَقِّ, the numeral وَٰحِدَة, and the result clauses (جَٰثِمِينَ, خَٰمِدُونَ, غُثَآءً, كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ, مُحْضَرُونَ, يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ) — not by the noun. It must not be encoded as root content.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Definiteness tracks syntax (anaphoric subject-of-seizing → definite; counted object → indefinite), not meaning. The punitive and mundane poles are bridged Quran-internally: the same phrase صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً spans kill (54:31) and raise (36:53); عَلَيْهِمْ is shared by divine Blast (54:31) and mundane shout (63:4); بِٱلْحَقِّ is shared by destroying (23:41) and summoning (50:42); and 50:42 makes even the eschatological Blast an object of hearing, the same nucleus 63:4 exhibits.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: Two honest limits, recorded as first-class results, not failures: (1) audibility is directly attested only at 50:42, so the sound-content of the six-verse seizure cluster is inferential rather than independently demonstrated; (2) whether صَيْحَة denotes a vocal cry or any loud non-vocal report/blast is underdetermined by the packet, as is whether صَيْحَة in the pulverization verses (23:41, 54:31) is literal sound or metonym for the destructive Event named by its sonic onset.

hard_cases.reason: Sole mundane, non-lethal, كُلّ-countable use; it is the counterexample that disproves any 'صَيْحَة = divine annihilating Blast' nucleus and forces the sense down to a plain audible cry/shout. It does not resist the thin acoustic nucleus — it confirms it — but it is the decisive adversarial boundary against the inflated reading.

evidence_basis.statement: 63:4:14:1 «يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ» — the hypocrites reckon EVERY ṣayḥah is against them: an indefinite, كُلّ-pluralized, mundane, non-lethal social outcry. This one verse strips 'cosmic', 'unique', 'divine-agent', and 'lethal' out of the nucleus, proving the destructive force in the other twelve is contextual, not lexical, and forcing the root sense down to a plain audible cry/shout.

hard_cases.reason: Pulverization outcome (كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ) after a sound 'sent upon them' invites a physical-blast reading, the point of maximum pressure on the pure-acoustic nucleus; reconciled as contextual because the effect is asserted by فَكَانُوا and never described acoustically.

evidence_basis.statement: Residual tension at 54:31:4:1: a sound 'sent upon them' that pulverizes reads as a physical blast, but the mechanism is never described acoustically and the effect is asserted by فَكَانُوا, so it is contextual.

hard_cases.reason: Reduction of bodies to غُثَاء (scum) carries destructive-event weight beyond pure sound, the second point of pressure on the acoustic nucleus; reconciled as contextual because the effect is asserted by فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ, never acoustically.

evidence_basis.statement: Residual tension: 23:41:2:2 «فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءً» reduces bodies to scum, weight beyond pure acoustics — but the effect is asserted by فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ, never described acoustically, so it is contextual, not lexical.

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence is finally RESISTANT under the preferred thin acoustic nucleus — all 13 are CONSISTENT. The hard cases are adversarial/atypical boundaries: 63:4 is the counterexample that refutes the inflated punitive nucleus, and 54:31/23:41 are the pulverization verses that maximally pressure the pure-acoustic reading. Each is reconciled by evidence (result-clause externality; intra-verse contrast), and each evidence statement is persisted verbatim in strongest_counterexample or in a cluster note.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quranic occurrence of صَيْحَة in which the noun itself — not the surrounding verb (أَخَذَ/أَرْسَلْنَا), modifier (بِٱلْحَقِّ/وَٰحِدَة), or result clause — lexically supplies destruction, a fixed source, or a message, would refute the universal force-neutral acoustic nucleus and show the root, not context, carries the punitive/eschatological load.
rejection_condition.search_location: The seizure cluster 11:67:4:2, 11:94:14:2, 15:73:2:2, 15:83:2:2, 23:41:2:2, 29:40:12:2 and the sent-Blast 54:31:4:1, tested against the hearing anchor 50:42:3:2 and the mundane shout 63:4:14:1.
rejection_condition.verification_method: For each occurrence strip the collocated seizing/sending verb and result clause and ask whether صَيْحَة alone still entails death; check whether any verse predicates destruction of the noun independently of أَخَذَ/أَرْسَلْنَا/فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ/فَكَانُوا, and whether any verse blocks the 'heard sound' reading established at 50:42.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not let the 12/13 distributional skew toward annihilation frames, nor the definite article on ٱلصَّيْحَة (which is discourse-anaphoric), be mistaken for lexical content; require the destructive/source meaning to be predicated of the noun itself, controlling for high frequency and for the punitive collocations.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such an occurrence is found, the universal force-neutral nucleus is rejected in favour of a lexicalized 'divine Blast' class (LEXICALIZED_CLASS), and 63:4 would be re-scoped as a marginal homonymous 'shout'.

reopen_conditions: If a future analysis argues that the pulverization result clauses at 23:41:2:2 (غُثَآءً) and 54:31:4:1 (كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ) encode a physical-shockwave sense IN the noun صَيْحَة rather than in فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ/فَكَانُوا, reopen to test literal-blast vs metonymy-for-the-Event.

If the audibility of the six-verse seizure cluster (11:67:4:2, 11:94:14:2, 15:73:2:2, 15:83:2:2, 23:41:2:2, 29:40:12:2) is challenged on the ground that it rests inferentially on the single سمع attestation at 50:42:3:2, reopen to reassess whether the auditory feature is demonstrated or merely bridged for that cluster.
If cross-root evidence forces a decision on the currently UNRESOLVED narrow question of vocal-cry vs non-vocal loud-report for صَيْحَة, reopen to refine the nucleus beyond 'audible sound-event'.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The refutation targeted the inflated 'destructive/cosmic Blast' nucleus and it was disproven internally (54:31↔36:53 kill-vs-raise on identical صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً; 63:4 mundane non-lethal). The surviving thin acoustic-singulative nucleus was then tested for falsifiability (63:4 could have contradicted it but instead exhibits the plain heard-cry sense) and for distinctiveness (29:40 names صَيْحَة as the sonic modality distinct from حَاصِب/خَسْف/إغراق, so it is not a generic 'destruction' or generic 'event' word). No occurrence contradicts the auditory-singulative nucleus, so failing_occurrences is empty.
